correctness.rationale: Graph-theoretic enumeration gives 1+r(r−1) cycles; distinct-leaf counting upper bounds depth. Previously published VC theorem gives values for every rim size. The exact W6 depth-four 16-leaf tree was reconstructed via independently enumerated graph cycles. Subdividing edges and retaining representative edge queries embeds that tree in all larger wheels. Fixed-spoke clockwise arc subfamilies realize ordered thresholds with a full binary search tree of depth floor(log2(r−1)). The boundary r=3,4 values use exact VC and cardinality upper bounds; computations r=3..8 are corroborative, not a substitute for universal proof.
